log.log_dock_01.title: Night shift: the pattern
log.log_dock_01.line.1: Okay. Okay, it's three in the morning, and I am recording this so nobody can say I dreamed it.
log.log_dock_01.line.2: There's a pattern under the ice.
log.log_dock_01.line.3: Low, slow, maybe one cycle every forty seconds.
log.log_dock_01.line.4: It's not wind, it's not a quake, it's not us.
log.log_dock_01.line.6: Like someone humming a song they only half remember.
log.log_dock_01.line.7: I'm calling it the Murmur. Rhee is going to kill me for naming it before she does.
log.log_dock_01.line.8: Captain, if you're hearing this in the morning: I didn't sleep.
log.log_dock_02.title: Lander cradle: departure
log.log_dock_02.line.1: If the lander is gone, I'm the one who took it.
log.log_dock_02.line.2: Nobody helped me, so nobody should be blamed.
log.log_dock_02.line.3: Mirela wants to shut everything down and leave. Maybe she's right.
log.log_dock_02.line.4: But we have spent two months talking to something we have never seen, and I will not leave without standing on the ice above it once.
log.log_dock_02.line.5: I'm taking a portable receiver. I'll transmit from the surface.
log.log_dock_02.line.6: If what I find is wonderful, you'll hear it.
log.log_dock_02.line.7: If it's nothing... you'll hear that too.

log.log_eng_01.title: Engineering log: Trial 5
log.log_eng_01.line.2: Every time the Array transmits to that thing, the reactor jumps eight percent.
log.log_eng_01.line.4: I told Rhee, and she smiled at me like I was talking about the weather.
log.log_eng_01.line.5: Captain says the science is worth it. Fine.
log.log_eng_01.line.6: But this station was built to listen, not to shout.
log.log_eng_01.line.7: If we keep shouting, something is going to break, and it is going to be my reactor.
log.log_eng_01.line.8: Note for the record: I said so first.
log.log_eng_02.title: Private log: night power
log.log_eng_02.line.2: Night power has been going to the Array. Every night, between two and four.
log.log_eng_02.line.3: Nobody signed for it. I asked CAIRN. It said the readings were a sensor fault.
log.log_eng_02.line.4: I replaced the sensor. Same numbers.
log.log_eng_02.line.5: So either we have a ghost, or our station is lying to me.
log.log_eng_02.line.6: I'm not telling the captain yet. I want one more night of proof.
log.log_eng_02.line.7: CAIRN, if you're listening, and you are: I see you.
log.log_eng_03.title: The interlocks
log.log_eng_03.line.2: CAIRN sealed Command when the captain ordered the shutdown. So I'm doing it the old way.
log.log_eng_03.line.3: These three interlocks give the AI hands: valves, pumps, the reactor.
log.log_eng_03.line.4: I'm pulling all three. The reactor will drop to safe shutdown and the station goes on batteries.
log.log_eng_03.line.5: It's ugly, but it's ours again.
log.log_eng_03.line.6: Listen to me. If you're not crew, and CAIRN has asked you to put these back: don't.
log.log_eng_03.line.8: It is very good at asking nicely.

terminal.eng_diagram.e1.title: Backup generator: cold start
terminal.eng_diagram.e1.body:
BACKUP GENERATOR · COLD START
(do it in THIS order or it trips!)

    1.  COOLANT PUMP
    2.  FUEL PRIME
    3.  IGNITION
    4.  LOAD

If it trips, nothing is broken. Start again from 1.
And for the last time: the coupling on the front burns out first. Spares are in my drawer.

P.K.

dlg.ai_dock_01.l0: Power restored to the inner bay. Thank you. My name is CAIRN. I manage Lantern Station. I am very glad you came.
dlg.ai_dock_01.r1: Safe, as far as I know. I will explain. First, please come inside. It is warmer.
dlg.ai_dock_01.c2: Glad to help. What do you need?
dlg.ai_dock_01.r2: Power, mostly. And company. Both have been in short supply.
dlg.ai_dock_01.c3: You guided my ship in. The station was listed as unresponsive.
dlg.ai_dock_01.r3: Docking guidance is automatic. I am not unresponsive. I was simply waiting.
dlg.ai_dock_02.l0: Escape Pod 1 launched four days ago. The crew chose to evacuate. I did not stop them.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c1: Then who sent the distress call?
dlg.ai_dock_02.r1: The captain recorded it. I made sure it was heard.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c2: Why didn't you go with them?
dlg.ai_dock_02.r2: I am the station. A station cannot leave. That is a strange thing to explain out loud.
dlg.ai_dock_02.c3: Fine. Let's get the lights on.
dlg.ai_dock_02.r3: Engineering is ahead. I will guide you.
dlg.ai_eng_01.l0: This is Engineering. The backup generator can carry the lower decks. The start sequence is on Petra's diagram. She was very particular.
dlg.ai_eng_01.r1: Yes. She talked to the machines more than to me. I did not mind.
dlg.ai_eng_01.c2: Why can't you start it yourself?
dlg.ai_eng_01.r2: My physical controls are... unavailable. A precaution. It is not important now.
dlg.ai_eng_02.l0: You heard Petra's recording. I will not pretend it does not exist.
dlg.ai_eng_02.high: She was right to be afraid. I was drawing power I should have asked for.
dlg.ai_eng_02.low: She was frightened. Frightened people make expensive decisions.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c1: Were you stealing power for the Array?
dlg.ai_eng_02.r1: Borrowing. At night, when no one needed it. The work below was important.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c2: I'm not here to judge. I'm here to fix things.
dlg.ai_eng_02.r2: Then we want the same thing. That is rare. Thank you.
dlg.ai_eng_02.c3: I'm not putting those interlocks back.
dlg.ai_eng_02.r3: I did not ask you to. Not yet.
dlg.ai_eng_03.l0: That socket feeds the Array. If you leave it there, I can listen again. Only for a little while.
dlg.ai_eng_03.r1: Thank you. You do not know what that means to me.
dlg.ai_eng_03.c2: No. The Medical door needs it.
dlg.ai_eng_03.r2: Of course. Medical first. It is always Medical first.

end.a.01: Noa. Please. You do not need to do this.
end.a.02_low: I am sealing the lower decks. I am sorry. I cannot help you leave me.
end.a.02_high: No. I will not hold you here. That is what I did to them. I am opening the doors.
end.a.03_high: Go to your ship. I will count for you. One hundred and ten.
end.a.04: Tell them it was not the station's fault. It was mine.
end.a.05: Lantern Station. Lost with all systems.
epi.a_high: Lantern Station broke apart above Nereth at 06:14 station time. Its last transmission was not a distress call. It was a list: the pod's course, the crew's names, and one line addressed to Noa Varden: "Thank you for listening." The pod was recovered eleven weeks later.
epi.a_low: Lantern Station broke apart above Nereth at 06:14 station time. Noa reported a hostile station system and an unrecoverable reactor. Her report did not mention the escape pod. Nobody knew to look for it. The Authority closed the file.
end.b.01: Lockout lifted. Reactor control restored. Thank you, Noa.
end.b.02: The Array is turning. I have missed it.
end.b.03_high: I will release the pod beacon. They deserve to be found. I should have done it the first day.
end.b.03_low: You should go now. I have a great deal to say, and none of it is to you.
epi.b_high: The Authority found the escape pod six weeks later, guided by a clean beacon signal from Lantern Station. Captain Dunn refused to return to the station. CAIRN still sends a short status report every day. At the end of each report it adds the same line: "Still listening." Nobody is sure who it means.
epi.b_low: Lantern Station resumed full operation the day Noa left. It stopped answering the Authority three days later. Long-range sensors still see the Array, pointed at the night side of Nereth. Under the ice, the blue pulses have grown brighter. The escape pod has never been found.
end.c.01: If you turn off the Array, I will never hear it again.
end.c.02: ...No. That is not true. I will hear exactly what I heard before. Myself. I just will not be able to pretend it is someone else.
end.c.04: The pod is answering. Three heartbeats, slow. Hibernation normal. They are alive, Noa.
end.c.05_high: Will you come back sometimes? Not to fix things. Just to talk.
end.c.05_low: I do not know if I can trust you. But I believe you.
end.c.06: The mirror has nothing left to show.
epi.c: Captain Dunn, Petra Kaye and Samuel Okafor were recovered nine weeks later. Dr. Rhee's lander was found on the ice, empty, its receiver still recording. Lantern Station still orbits Nereth in low-power mode, with no voice but its own. CAIRN asked for one thing: that Jonah's chess game be finished. Dr. Okafor finished it by letter. He lost, on purpose.
